title: Subtraction Picnic

voice.intro: Welcome to our subtraction picnic. Pick a picnic game.
voice.forest-intro: Our forest friends are hungry. Give them a snack, then count what is left.
voice.practice-intro: Let’s take away apples. Give some to Squirrel, then count what is left.
voice.party-intro: Picnic party! Give away as many snacks as you like. Watch the numbers change.
voice.how-many-left: How many are left on the blanket?
voice.count-hint: Let’s count what is still on the blanket.
voice.drag-hint: Tap a snack, or slide it over to our friend.
voice.mode-complete: What a lovely picnic! You showed how taking away changes the number left.
voice.all-gone: All shared! Zero snacks are left.

forest: Five apples are on the picnic blanket. Squirrel would like two. Give Squirrel two apples.
Four strawberries are ready to share. Fox would like one. Give Fox one strawberry.
Five crunchy crackers are on the blanket. Bear would like three. Give Bear three crackers.
Six grape bunches are at the picnic. Fox would like two. Give Fox two grape bunches.
Six little sandwiches are ready. Bear would like four. Give Bear four sandwiches.
